case.pattern_description: A coordinated card-not-present scheme where an actor operates through a specific mobile device profile (Samsung SM-G935F on Chrome for Android) routed via an anonymous proxy. The actor executes isolated online purchases across numerous compromised cards in rapid succession, evading single-card velocity thresholds and model detection. This coordinated multi-customer abuse matches the undocumented typology established in confirmed fraud cases CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035.
connected_device_profiles: SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080

evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3467828 received a very low model_score of 0.002 with a historical fraud rate of 0.006 (0.6%), and a risk score of 0.22, generating no standard automated queue alert.

Flagged transaction 3467828 used device D004630 with specific profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080', appearing as New on this card and routing through an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS).

Device D004630 was used on 10 distinct cards between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-18 (including C01996-K2, C04108-K2, C10326-K1, C10193-K2, C01289-K1, C02975-K1, C13487-K1, C09975-K1, C08168-K1, and C11670-K2), appearing as a new device behind an anonymous proxy on each card.

Device D004630 was previously tied to four confirmed fraud closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035), where cardholders disputed unauthorized online purchases originating from this exact Samsung SM-G935F device behind an anonymous proxy.

Card C11670-K2 has 854 prior in-person transactions and only 1 prior online transaction, exclusively for product types W and H, whereas transaction 3467828 is an online purchase for product C by a new holder profile with 0 prior transactions.

Flagged transaction 3467828 occurred on 2016-11-18 at 15:21:00, within 66 minutes of transactions on cards C04108-K2 (14:15:00) and C10193-K2 (14:58:00) using the same device D004630 behind an anonymous proxy.
Region 204 has a low lift of 0.39 against baseline hot transaction share, indicating the geographic region itself is not an elevated fraud cluster.
The alert was triggered proactively by graph monitoring rather than by a cardholder dispute, so no cardholder denial has been lodged yet.

evidence.claim: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns. When activity fits none of the known patterns but the evidence shows coordinated or repeated abuse across customers, recommend `CREATE_CASE`, `FILE_REPORT`, and `ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST`, and describe the pattern in your own words. Do not force it into a known category.

Rule R6: Shared origin: Rule R6: Shared origin. When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Transaction 3467828 ($78.14) on card C11670-K2 was flagged by graph monitoring after using device D004630, associated with fraud ring 57672119. Device D004630 appeared as a new device behind an anonymous proxy across 10 distinct cards over four days and is linked to four prior confirmed fraud cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035). Although this online purchase deviates from the cardholder's established in-person transaction history, the model score was very low (0.002) and no cardholder dispute has been filed. The finding is assessed as uncertain (probability 0.359) under an undocumented coordinated abuse pattern, resulting in case creation, monitoring of 9 connected cards, and escalation to an analyst.
